core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jamshaid is a Persian-origin name meaning “Bright, Shining King”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jamshaid corresponds to the Persian form جمشید (Persian جمشید (Jamshīd)). Its core sense is jamshid; a persian name of legendary kings. Jamshaid is Persian جمشید (Jamshīd), a male given name borne by a legendary king in the Shahnameh. MISLABELLED ORIGIN: the source recorded the name as Arabic. The source gloss 'Bright, Shining King' is unsupported and has been replaced with the documented identification. Same name as jamshed, jamsheed and jamshid.
